page_title: WOL 4-2 TOT | Wolves v Tottenham Hotspur 13/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham) prepares to take a corner kick.
90+4' The corner is aimed towards the penalty spot where it's met by Richarlison (Tottenham), but his timing is poor and it flies high over the bar.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
86' 4 - 2 Goal! Some very poor defending from the opponent allows Matheus Cunha (Wolves) the chance to get to the edge of the box and he makes no mistake with a lovely finish. It's 4:2.
86' Toti (Wolves) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Anthony Taylor had an easy-decision to make.
85' 3 - 2 Richarlison (Tottenham) scores with a header from inside the box after a goalmouth scramble.
85' Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) rises high to connect with a cross from the corner kick, but his powerful header from near the penalty spot crashes against the crossbar!
85' Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
83' Joao Gomes will be replaced by Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves).
80' Joao Gomes (Wolves) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the right post.
77' Rodrigo Gomes (Wolves) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
75' Ange Postecoglou has decided to substitute Dominic Solanke and he is replaced by Richarlison (Tottenham).
75' The game has come to an end for James Maddison. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham).
74' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) takes the free kick and unleashes a strong shot from the edge of the box. Unfortunately for him, the ball curls inches over the crossbar. What a squandered chance!

74' Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Wolves win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
70' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ben Davies (Tottenham) was quite harsh and Anthony Taylor didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
70' Here is a change. Jorgen Strand Larsen is going off and Vitor Pereira gives the last tactical orders to Rodrigo Gomes (Wolves).
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Matheus Cunha (Wolves) comes onto the pitch for Rayan Ait Nouri.
69' James Maddison (Tottenham) steps up and sends the mid-range free kick miles over the bar. Strong but inaccurate shot.
68' Andre (Wolves) trips an opposition player and Anthony Taylor signals a foul. Tottenham have a free kick from a promising distance.
64' 3 - 1 Goal! Rayan Ait Nouri passes the ball to the feet of Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves), who has an empty net in front of him and has no problems in tapping the ball in. 3:1.
63' Wolves are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
59' 2 - 1 Goal! Mathys Tel (Tottenham) beautifully controls a strongly hit pass from Brennan Johnson inside the box. He cuts inside his marker and rifles the ball into the left side of the goal. 2:1.
58' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

57' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a sitter. His shot was directed towards the right post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him. Wolves force their opponents to concede a corner.
55' Ange Postecoglou decides to make a substitution. Pape Matar Sarr will be replaced by Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham).
55' Substitution. Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Yves Bissouma walks off.
52' Andre (Wolves) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Tottenham will have a goal kick.

51' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) is picked out by his teammate with a brilliant short pass, but it takes him too long to control the ball inside the box and this allows one of the defending players to rob him.
50' Marshall Munetsi (Wolves) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
46' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
46' Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Tottenham win a corner.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Vitor Pereira probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Matt Doherty (Wolves). He is replaced by Santiago Bueno.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The end of the first half.

45+4' Matt Doherty (Wolves) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick has been awarded to Tottenham.
45+1' James Maddison (Tottenham) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
42' Vitor Pereira is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) suffers an injury and Pablo Sarabia comes on.
38' 2 - 0 Djed Spence (Tottenham) scores an unfortunate own goal after deflecting the ball into his own net!
37' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) is afforded space inside the box after collecting a pass, but the chance is wasted as his shot goes harmlessly over the crossbar.
35' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
29' The foul by Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) was seen by Anthony Taylor who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
28' Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar.
22' Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going inside the left post, but Jose Sa has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
21' James Maddison (Tottenham) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
19' Mathys Tel (Tottenham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. The ball has crossed the sideline. Tottenham are taking a throw-in.
17' Joao Gomes (Wolves) commits a foul and Anthony Taylor immediately signals a free kick.
13' What a miss! A floated cross from the flank picks out Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) unmarked near the penalty spot with just the keeper to beat, but he skies his header miles over the bar.
10' Mathys Tel (Tottenham) takes a first-time shot inside the box after latching onto a nice lofted pass, but the effort is blocked and spins away to safety.
8' Anthony Taylor shows a yellow card to Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) for his blatant foul.
8' James Maddison (Tottenham) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
6' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) spurned a good chance! He gets a shot away from inside the penalty box, but it goes inches wide of the right post.
5' Referee Anthony Taylor points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Wolves players celebrate.
4' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Wolves players aren’t happy.

2' 1 - 0 Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) gets to the ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot without any hesitation. The strike is excellent and goes inside the right post. He couldn't have done it any better. 1:0.

2' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
1' The first half has started.
Wolves will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Anthony Taylor.
